scope: Concept images only; existing class concepts preserved; no Blender or Unity assets modified.
visual_review: All 18 images individually reviewed. One unarmed full-body character per image; six true-T-pose turnarounds; class weapons, quivers and ammunition props removed. Clothing and anatomy references are not a dimensional CAD turnaround; final generated model still needs inspection.

records.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied Tianchao militia archer into the SAME character's modular infantry BASE BODY, FRONT orthographic view. Preserve his face, black cloth cap, worn patched grey long-sleeved tunic and trousers, faded dark red sash, beige shin wraps, cloth shoes and realistic game-concept rendering exactly. Change to a true symmetrical T-pose: straight arms extended horizontally sideways at shoulder height, open relaxed complete BARE hands, thumbs and four fingers, head facing straight forward, legs straight hip-width apart. Remove ALL weaponry and class accessories completely: bow, arrows, quiver, diagonal quiver strap, belt pouch, gourd, scabbard, ammunition bags. Retain only plain universal waist belt and red cloth sash. No armor on militia hands. ONE full-body character only, centered on neutral light grey background. Square canvas with complete fingertips and feet visible, ample margin, figure crown at 8% image height and soles at 92%; natural adult human proportions, not chibi. No text, no floor grid, no reference panels, no props beside the body, no turnaround collage. This is a clean Tripo modeling reference, flat soft neutral studio lighting.

ONE character, empty neutral grey background, square canvas, full body same head-to-foot scale as Image2. No text, no separate weapon, no multiple figures.
